task.description:
Produce a design artefact for API-09 (Request tracing) at src/design/api-tracing.md.

API-09 requires:
- Every request assigned a UUID v4 trace_id at request start
- If caller provides X-Trace-Id request header, that value is used (propagation)
- X-Trace-Id header included in every response
- trace_id appears in every log entry during that request
- trace_id appears in the trace_id field of any error response body
- Trace ID still assigned/returned even if auth fails (HTTP 401)
- Incoming X-Trace-Id that is not a valid UUID must be accepted as-is (no validation)

Design the module interface, types, and integration points:
1. A trace middleware that runs FIRST in the middleware chain (before auth)
2. How trace_id flows through request context to logging and error responses
3. UUID v4 generation strategy (std.crypto.random or similar)
4. How existing error response structure (src/api/errors.zig) gets trace_id field added
5. How structured logging (OBS-01) carries trace_id in each log entry

Per the backend developer guide §6 format: include Module name, Zig source files, Public types, Public functions, Error types, and Integration notes.
acceptance_criteria: Covers all acceptance criteria from API-09 requirement
Specifies trace middleware position in chain (first, before auth)
Defines how trace_id propagates to logging and error responses
Addresses edge cases: caller-supplied X-Trace-Id, non-UUID X-Trace-Id, auth failures

result.summary: Design artefact for api-tracing (API-09): trace middleware, trace_context thread-local, ProblemDetails extension, OBS-01 logger integration, and X-Trace-Id header injection strategy.
